For an overview of the development of BASF's early recording tapes, see Zimmermann Paul A. , “Magnetic Tapes, Magnetic Powders, Electrodes: New Communication Media,” Ludwig-shafen/Rhein , Basf , 1969 . A more detailed discussion of the manufacturing processes involved with these early tapes can be found in Richard A. Ranger, Fiat Final Report No. 923, “Further Studies in Magnetophones and Tapes,” Washington, D.C., Technical Industrial Intelligence Div., U.S. Dept. of Commerce, 1947, pp. 46ff.
